spec: DATA_MODEL.md §18 module 12 — firms 2 (`Demo Capital` 5 seats, `Other Desk` for the isolation tests).
note: Two firms, not one, because every firm-scoped guarantee in this system is unfalsifiable against a single tenant: an RLS policy that forgets its firm predicate, a watchlist listed by firm, a room scoped to a firm and an ENTL-06 declaration all pass trivially when there is only one firm id in the database. `Other Desk` exists so those tests have somebody to be excluded.
leiNote: `lei` is null on both rows. A LEI is a registered identifier that resolves to a real legal entity in GLEIF; minting a syntactically valid one for a demo firm would put a fabricated identifier into a column readers are entitled to trust (DATA-10's spirit, REF-04). Absent is the honest value.

firms.name: Demo Capital
firms.seatCountNote: 5 is the contracted seat count of DATA_MODEL §18, not a count of the seeded users (six of the seven live here). ENTL-06 reconciles declarations against this number, so deriving it from the user table would make the reconciliation compare a value with itself and always agree.
